sources.title: How Tall Was Napoleon Bonaparte? Actually Pretty Average | HowStuffWorks
Napoleon Bonaparte Having Been Short is a Myth
sources.excerpt: In modern international units, he was just shy of 5 feet 7 inches

reasoning: The claim that Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short and around 5 feet 2 inches tall is false. The height of 5 feet 2 inches was recorded in pre-metric French units (French feet and inches), which were longer than English units. In modern English measurements, Napoleon was actually about 5 feet 6 inches (or 1.68 meters) tall, which was average or even slightly above average for a French man of his era.
